culprit_citations.quoted_text: Total Controlled Affiliated Investments | Fair Value at March 31, 2026 | 222,075,628

findings.detail: The controlled-affiliate rollforward repeats schedule positions and contributes 222,075,628 from a secondary table to the position extract.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows a real over-coverage defect. The filing's primary debt-and-equity schedule totals 249,694,433 at table 5 row 31. The reconciled extract is 438,466,761. That extract is exactly 249,694,433 less the separately filtered 33,303,300 NAV position plus the 222,075,628 controlled-affiliate rollforward total at table 6 row 29. Table 6 is a fair-value rollforward of investments already present in the primary schedule, so its rows were extracted a second time. The resulting difference of 188,772,328 is fully explained by this duplicated secondary-table block net of the NAV exclusion.
